responsibility: Defines GCC’s main value-range data structures and APIs: the vrange base class, integer irange representation, floating frange representation, kind/discriminator enums, visitor hooks, nonzero-bit support, NaN/signbit queries, canonical range constructors, and helper functions for representable floating endpoints. This header is the type foundation for ranger, VRP, and range operators across integer, pointer, and floating analyses.
same_name_distinction: Defines the vrange, irange, and frange classes and their public/inlined APIs, whereas value-range.cc supplies the non-inline method implementations and selftests. This header is the type-definition side of the value-range pair.
